scope: Procedural local social exchanges, audible-only LLM narration and queue backpressure
limits: Only loaded local individuals participate; no global per-tribe conversation simulation.
NPC social exchange does not require model inference; natural-language rendering still depends on local model speed.
No FPS improvement claimed; functional tests are capped at 30 FPS.

native_runs.reason: Live optional conversation admitted but no inference started; investigating admission versus physical hearing at subsequent frames.
Live model optional exchange was discarded before inference. Dispatch trace added to distinguish hearing, expiry and spatial eligibility.
Live speech fixture did not satisfy actual hearing admission after settling.
Dispatch started model loading, then momentary hearing occlusion canceled it. Trace preserved; led to bounded in-progress hearing grace.
Grace checks passed, but combat-style hearing obstruction still rejected the physical live fixture. Replaced with acoustic barrier rules; moved speech fixture away from household structures.
Stable audible inference and streaming established; reply chain did not complete. Added explicit recipient fallback for spoken replies whose target is none.

native_runs.live_model: Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M, hybrid CUDA, 2 GiB GPU reserve, 15 FPS inference cap
proof: Actual scheduler shares a witnessed theft with AI disabled and player out of earshot.

Two actual residents deliver streamed live-model turns, then player interrupts and receives a real reply.
Captured state and real possession IDs validate.
